key.name: pixel-shift
key.summary: Shift the top bar by one pixel along the ASUS OLED Shifter orbit

key.name: panel-autohide
key.summary: Hide the top bar until the pointer reaches the top screen edge

key.name: panel-transparent
key.summary: Draw the top bar without background

key.name: dim-inactive
key.summary: Darken all windows except the focused one

key.name: dim-level
key.summary: How much inactive windows are darkened (0 = not at all)
